Convert sportsbook promos into clearer, faster profit decisions.

PromoGrind gives you the calculator stack, tracking surface, and operator-style dashboard to work through bonus bets, boosts, arbitrage, EV, and bankroll decisions without a bloated subscription wall. Create a free PromoGrind account if you want sync across devices. No credit card required.

🧮
Calculator stack
Bonus bets, boosts, arb, EV, Kelly, parlay hedge, no-vig, insurance, rollover, and more.

Operator dashboard
Log real outcomes, review weekly progress, and stop guessing where your edge is coming from.
⚡

Trust-first framing

Profit Boost Calculator

inspection.reviewer: Codex via view_image: all 20 production before and all 20 staging after PNG captures
findings: The staged landing hero and legal footer preserve the production layout in dark and light themes at 1440x1000 and 390x844; captured states show no horizontal document overflow.
Staged pricing plan names, prices and availability marks are readable in both themes; desktop cards and mobile stacked cards preserve their structure and planned-checkout labels.
The House contact control uses contrasting ink in both themes and remains visible on desktop and mobile.
All five plan-title colors measured from staging clear 4.5:1 on their rendered card backgrounds: minimum 5.08:1 in dark and 6.12:1 in light.
The service worker freshness change is behavior-tested separately; visual captures intentionally bypass service workers to inspect the deployed artifact.
fixesApplied: Replaced static pricing text accents with the existing semantic theme palette for titles, prices, availability marks and active checkout text; preserved decorative tier badges and borders.
Changed the House contact button to a semantic accent background and theme-appropriate contrasting ink.
Made same-origin extensionless navigation network-first with offline cached fallback, preventing previously cached HTML from hiding releases.
inspection.coverage: Landing top/footer and pricing top/plan/House states; not a claim that every application screen was reviewed.
